Method of Attack: Unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) as root by removing authentication header
Silent installation of OMI agent with highest privileges without user consent
Exploitation allows initial access and lateral movement within Azure environments
Discoverer: Wiz researchers Nir Ohfeld and Shir Tamari
Impacted Systems: On-premise systems with manually installed OMI agent
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in OMI agent silently installed on Azure Linux VMs
Removal of authentication header in network packets
